minutes_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, September 15, 2021
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, September 15, 2021.
  Members present: Lorraine Missick, Terry Kistler, George Borst, Jenny Jolly, Bette
  Donovan and Scott Snider.
  Members absent: None.
  Staff Present: Yvonne Duran, Community Services Manager and Amanda Triay,
  Community Services Specialist.
  Guests present: None.
  Minutes: No minutes; they will be submitted at the next meeting.
  Unfinished Business
2. Senior Nutrition Program: An average of 97 meals served per week to curbside
  recipients in August.

3. Guest Speaker: Yvonne, Community Services Manager.

  Yvonne: The updated and current positions for the Community Services Department
  are as follows: Yvonne Duran, Community Services Manager/Department Head,
  Chad Peterson, Community Services Supervisor, Jesse Cervantes, Community
  Services Coordinator, Amanda Triay, Community Services Specialist, Jorge Bugarin,
  Maintenance Worker I- Facilities, and Cindi Harchut, Administrative Clerk.

  Yvonne also reported that Amanda will be officially moving into her old office in the
  Community Center. The new recreation guide will be out at the end of the month.

  The Christmas Morning Committee has been formed. The Fire Department will no
  longer be in charge of the Christmas morning activities. Robin Carter will be in
  charge. The first meeting is scheduled for September 29th.

  Paulina Flores is our new Police Chief. The new City Budget is available on the city
  website. The new city website will be coming at the end of the year with a new City
  of La Verne logo. Member terms for the Senior Advisory Committee are coming up.
 4. Bingo Report: $150 was paid for facility use of the Community Center. Participants of
  Bingo are charged 50 cents per person. Prize money is currently down due to the
  attendance count which was 23 people in attendance one week and 52 in
  attendance last week. There is a need for more paper bingo sheets and volunteers
  to collect money. There is a new person who is taking care of the money. Bingo is
  hoping to go back to normal payments soon. The Bingo checking account balance is
  $2400.

5. Meals on Wheels: 745 meals were delivered in August to La Verne residents. La
  Verne and San Dimas had 1,115 meals delivered or about 50 meals per day for 22
  days.

6. Account Balance: $2,221.93

7. Senior Program Fees: Bingo paid their fees. Garden Friends and Line Dancing are
  back. Antique Clock Repair is a new class that is offered every Tuesday afternoon.

8. Mt. SAC Classes: All classes are back.

9. Aging Next: 2 meals were delivered and 17 clients had cases managed in La Verne.

  New Business

10. Upcoming Events:
  Wednesday, September 22nd– Line Dancing Class, Beginners Class 2:00-3:00
  PM and Intermediate Class 3:00-4:00 PM
  nd
  Wednesday, September 22 –The Importance of Foot Health presented by
  Casa Colina, 10:00 AM
  Monday, October 4th & 18th – International Line Dancing, Basic Beginner Class
  1:00-2:00 PM, Basic Cardio Class 2:00-3:00 PM
  th
  Saturday, October 9 –Trunk-or-Treat, City Hall Parking Lot, 5:00-8:00 PM
  Monday, October 25th –Line Dancing Class, Beginners Class 2:00-3:00
  PM and Intermediate Class 3:00-4:00 PM
  th
  Tuesday, October 26 –Health & Resource Fair, Community Center,
  9:00-11:00 AM
  Friday, October 29th –Special Needs Dance, Community Center, 5:00-8:00 PM
  Saturday, October 30th –Downtown Trick or Treating, 2:00-5:00 PM

11. Facilities Report: Professional cleaning services are coming in to clean. Pool lights
  at Las Flores Park will be replaced soon. At the Veterans Hall Memorial they will be
  adding Merchant Marine flags and Space Force flags. New plants are also being
  added. There will be a Veterans Day ceremony on November 11th.
 12. Public Comments: Jenny asked about classes and the procedure for attending.
  There are no temperature checks but all class participants need to sign

  Scott: An update on Hillcrest was given. They are still checking for fever symptoms
  and other symptoms when visitors arrive. Vaccination cards/status is being checked
  as well.

  George gave an update on the Senior Golf Tournament and the golfing on Tuesdays
  at Marshall Canyon. The management there is up for bids, but they are staying there
  for now. If possible a golf tournament maybe helped at San Dimas. The league
  hopes to gold at both places.

  Amanda: Currently trying to bring back the Health Fair and the dinner dances.
  Chick’s memorial date will be announced.

13. Adjourn: A motion was moved and seconded to adjourn the meeting, motion
  approved and carried. The meeting was adjourned at 11:15 AM. Next meeting will
  be held at the Community Center on October 20, 2021 at 10:00 AM.
